licensing_audit.dataset: SEC EDGAR public filings and company metadata
licensing_audit.finding: SEC states its government-created content and EDGAR public filing content are free to access and reuse. The public data APIs require no API key. Submissions metadata and financial XBRL are structured, but no complete current executive/director roster API was established. DEF 14A, 10-K and subsequent 8-K role changes require extraction and reconciliation. Follow SEC fair-access limits; do not copy unrelated stock photography.

An openly reusable knowledge base exists and can augment names, entity identifiers and coordinates. Completeness and currentness of all executive/director memberships were not established. Official issuer or SEC evidence should verify roles. Wikidata prose/media licenses differ from structured facts.

licensing_audit.license: No general open license established for page text or media
licensing_audit.finding: This deliverable transcribes minimal public name/title facts with source links, not biographies, photos or page designs. A paid roster vendor is not necessary for this five-issuer reference dataset. This is not a determination that every third-party database can be bulk imported or commercially redistributed.
Public address-range geocoder; coordinates are explicitly interpolated or approximated. No API key or payment was needed. Matching the address does not establish exact building/entrance coordinates.

AEP matched a named mapped office building. Preserve attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors and ODbL notice. Public Nominatim requires an identifying User-Agent, at most one request per second, cached results and no generic automated geocoding service integration without deliberate developer choice. ODbL share-alike obligations may apply to distributed derived databases.

mic_standard.note: MICs normalize issuer exchange names; they are not a claim of exclusive listing.

limitations: Research is scoped to AMD, CVX, VZ, AEP and T. No complete-market import or paid vendor used.
Retrieved date is observation date, not page publication/as-of date. Undated rosters keep publication and as_of null.
No biographies, photographs, birth dates, personal contact data, homes, travel, or personal coordinates are included.
Roles are those explicitly listed publicly. Do not infer employment location from an issuer affiliation.
Future announced changes are separate and must not replace observed roles before their effective dates.

Pins are verified public company business addresses. AMD, CVX, VZ and T coordinates are address-range interpolation, not rooftop precision. AEP is an OpenStreetMap mapped office-building point. Never label any pin as an executive location.

OpenStreetMap-derived AEP coordinates require OpenStreetMap attribution and ODbL notice; preserve the source URL and license. Results were cached from a small, one-time, rate-limited lookup. Do not build the public Nominatim endpoint into a generic in-app geocoding service.
